- **q1:** March Completed orders total **£8,174.75**.
- **q2:** Q2 net revenue by region: North **£12,567.90**, East **£10,112.25**, South **£9,421.10**, West **£6,294.75**.
- **q3:** Desk Chair revenue grew from **£7,112.25** in Q1 to **£12,955.75** in Q2: an increase of **82.2%**.
- **q4:** The discounted order value of Refunded and Cancelled orders was **£11,732.15**.
- **q5:** Copperfield Law had the highest Jan–June net revenue, at **£7,177.25**.
- **q6:** Q1 net revenue was **£36,048.65** across **65** Completed orders, averaging **£554.59** per order.
